meta.name: alterlab-flowio
meta.description: Parse and write FCS (Flow Cytometry Standard) files v2.0-3.1 with FlowIO — extract event data as NumPy arrays, read $-keyword metadata and channel/parameter definitions, and convert events to CSV or pandas DataFrame. Use when loading raw .fcs flow-cytometry files, inspecting channels and metadata, or preprocessing cytometry data for downstream gating and analysis. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 读取并转换流式细胞术FCS文件为可分析格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理流式细胞术的FCS文件，需要提取事件数据做分析。
copy.tagline_en: Parse and convert flow cytometry FCS files into analyzable formats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with FCS files from flow cytometry and need to extract event data for analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取和写入 FCS 格式的流式细胞术文件，提取事件数据为 NumPy 数组，查看通道信息和元数据，并将数据转换为 CSV 或 pandas DataFrame。
howto.when: 当你需要加载 .fcs 文件、查看通道和元数据，或预处理细胞术数据用于后续分析时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 FCS 文件，显示事件数和通道名称。

say.note: Claude 会转换数据并生成 CSV。

say.text: 提取 FCS 文件中的荧光通道数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read and write FCS (Flow Cytometry Standard) files, extract event data as NumPy arrays, inspect channel information and metadata, and convert events to CSV or pandas DataFrame.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to load .fcs files, inspect channels and metadata, or preprocess cytometry data for downstream analysis.
